message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a portrait of a man, Muhammad Yamin, centered on a light-textured background. He wears a pinstriped blue-grey suit jacket over a white collared shirt and a diagonally striped orange and grey tie. His dark hair is styled with a slight wave across his forehead. He has dark eyes and a neutral expression.

The masthead "TEMPO" is positioned at the top in large, bold black capital letters. Above it, smaller text reads "Edisi Khusus Hari Kemerdekaan." To the left, the name "Muhammad Yamin" is printed in red, followed by "1903-1962" and several lines of Indonesian text in a smaller, darker font. A stylized red and white circular emblem with the number "69" is located on the right side. The date "18-24 AGUSTUS 2014" is in the upper right corner. At the bottom left, a barcode, a price of "RP 40.000", and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO" are visible. The illustration style has a painterly, textured appearance.
